help.title: What is this?
help.paragraph_1: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI agents securely access your workspace. You control what they can do with granular permissions.
help.paragraph_2: When an AI agent tries to perform a sensitive action — like deleting a customer or creating a payment — you'll be asked to confirm it inside the AI app before anything happens.
help.paragraph_3: You can revoke access anytime; the agent loses all access immediately.
